verdict.rationale: RealtimeKit provides a few event-driven automations of its own: it can generate an AI summary when a meeting ends, and it can deliver signed meeting, participant, and recording events to your backend. There is no evidence of a general rules engine where users define their own conditions and actions; arbitrary automation must be built in your own backend. missing for 10: user-definable rule/condition configuration, a catalog of triggerable actions beyond summaries, documented rule management, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Generate an AI summary when a meeting ends.
Receive signed meeting, participant, and recording events in your backend.
